msg: I chose my strategy based on the colours of the hats mostly as I noticed a pattern there. Whenever I was with 1x chances and was presented with both men with hats. if they were both short, I chose the hat with the less stand out color. If one was taller than the other, I chose the shorter one.For the 5x rounds, I chose any of them (either short and tall) depending on the color of their hat, i noticed i collected more points at the 5x rounds when choosing vibrant colors suh as pink, purple, blue.
